verdict.rationale: The engine is published as open source on GitHub at playcanvas/engine and described as an open-source game engine. A runtime probe confirms the engine runtime is MIT-licensed, so developers can freely read, fork and modify it. Community comments independently describe it as an open source JavaScript engine. Missing for 10: documentation on building or patching the engine from source and using a modified build in a project; no evidence that the hosted Editor's source is similarly open.
